name: Moya Letnyaya Podrabotka: Khelluinsky Speshial
source:
You and your friends have arrived at the festival to celebrate Halloween, but a terrible storm breaks out outside. What do you do?

Gather around the table and play D&D, of course!

[From [url=https://multiverse-ballance.itch.io/my-summer-job-halloween-special]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你和朋友们来到庆典现场准备欢度万圣节，窗外却突然刮起了猛烈的暴风雨。这时候该怎么办呢？

当然是围坐到桌前一起跑团玩《龙与地下城》啦！

[摘自[url=https://multiverse-ballance.itch.io/my-summer-job-halloween-special]itch.io[/url]]
